plan.title: RFQ auto title for same-family products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply the RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add two products matching the available product search; this is the closest catalog operation to creating two same-family rows.
